overview: Redesign of Shadow AI browser assistant from dark neon (#0A0B10 / #00F0FF) to a crisp, modern Google Chrome Light UI (#DEE1E6 tab strip, white toolbar, #F1F3F4 omnibox, #1A73E8 Google blue accent). Features collapsible and resizable left/right panels, hideable workspace bar for full-screen browser view, plain arrow cursor for canvas, and sharp navigation arrows throughout.

canvas_and_mouse.canvas_overlay_instructions: Canvas uses standard plain arrow mouse pointer (cursor: default), zero crosshairs or plus icons. High responsiveness chromium video stream.

iconography_rules.arrow_icons: Use sharp arrow icons (e.g. ChevronRight, ChevronLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, ChevronDown) for all collapse, expand, back, forward, and step actions. NEVER use '+' for arrows or navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor App and all child components to implement the Light Theme Google Chrome UI.
Replace dark background classes with Chrome light equivalents (#DEE1E6 for tab strip, white for toolbar/panels, #F1F3F4 for omnibox, #1A73E8 for cyan replacement).
Implement drag-resizable and collapsible left side panel and right activity panel with custom handle styling.
Ensure the workspace bar has a toggle button in the toolbar to hide/show it for full-screen browser experience.
Ensure the Chromium canvas video/picture stream uses plain arrow mouse pointer (cursor-default) and sharp arrow indicators.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, collapse triggers, chips) MUST include data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid="chrome-tab-close", data-testid="side-panel-toggle").
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for headers, overlays, or floating menus.
Do NOT use '+' for arrow buttons or directional collapse controls. Use sharp Chevron/Arrow icons.
Ensure high contrast and clean spacing (WCAG AA compliant).
